# Snowball world model

`server/cstrike/models/snowwars/v090/weapons/w_snowball.mdl` was copied from the public Hedgehog Fog Snow Wars repository:

- Source: https://github.com/Hedgefog/cs-snow-wars
- Asset: `assets/models/snowwars/v090/weapons/w_snowball.mdl`
- Model attribution in the source repository: rflmm
- Repository license: MIT; see `LICENSE`.

The model is used only for thrown HE grenades while the `/snow` event is enabled. The first-person and player-held HE view remains the stock Counter-Strike model.
